messages:
alex: Heads up — planning to enable ionyx-v1 in the catalog during the 00:00–01:00 UTC change window tonight. Need to confirm fallback ordering, pin for sms-prod, and rollback triggers.
monica: Thanks. Canary plan? percentage and regions?
alex: Canary 5% global for first 15m, then 20% for 30m if metrics are ✅. Start in us-west then expand to eu-central.
jamal: ionyx memory footprint looks +8% on GPU during synth runs. If we see OOMs or queueing spike, we should rollback immediately.
mika: Add eval set run and quality gate — please don't promote if rouge answers > 1% on our core prompts.
alex: Agreed. Rollback criteria proposal: sustained p50 latency > 2x baseline for 5m OR error-rate > 0.5% for 5m OR quality delta > 1% on eval set. Any objections?
jamal: fine. also request: ensure fallback ordering puts the quantized 8bit variant before the older 13b legacy model for cost/latency parity.
monica: +1 to jamal. We should also pin sms-prod->ionyx@v1 for the canary route only; don't change default catalog pin yet.
oncall-sre: I will attach dashboards and alert pages. Alert thresholds need to be consistent with rollback criteria. Alert playbook updated.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: catalog.enable request queued by alex for ionyx-v1. Change window: 00:00 UTC. Canary policy: 5%->20%. Fallback ordering to be set as: [ionyx-8q, ionyx-v1, legacy-13b].
mika: Quick note — include the eval prompt id: eval/ionyx_coreset_v2 so we can see regressions in rollouts tab.
alex: Checklist I'll follow: 1) preflight perf test pass, 2) upgrade catalog entry with fallback order, 3) create canary route + pin, 4) start canary, 5) monitor 15m, 6) promote or rollback.
jamal: If rollback, ensure we unpin canary and restore catalog fallback ordering to previous config. Also open a short incident ticket with cause tags.
monica: Release notes: "ionyx: initial catalog enable (canary) — quantized variant preferred for fallback; quality + latency gates in place." I'll draft and share.
deploy-bot: canary started at 5319876600 for ionyx-v1 on route sms-prod (5%). Monitoring hooks: telemetry/ionyx-canary and alerts: latency-high, error-rate-high, eval-regression.
alex: Monitoring green at 10m. No regressions on eval set so far. Proceeding to 20% after 15m window.
monica: Copy. I'll hold on promo to global default until tomorrow morning post-sanity.
oncall-sre: Received — oncall watching. Will escalate to infra if queueing > 5s.
jamal: Noted one small spike at 00:12 but stabilized. No action.
alex: Canary at 20% now. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
deploy-bot: canary update: 20% applied at 5319876680.
mika: Saw a tiny quality blip at minute 22, 0.4% delta — below threshold. Keeping an eye.
alex: If things stay green, we'll leave canary pinned and schedule the global pin tomorrow 08:00 UTC. For rollback decision we use the criteria above. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
monica: :thumbsup:
jamal: ack
oncall-sre: ack
